name: kup
description: Fill the monthly KUP report (Polish 50% creative-work tax deduction) from your merged GitHub pull requests and write it to your KUP Google Sheet.

interface.shortDescription: Fill the monthly KUP report from merged PRs
interface.longDescription: Collects your merged GitHub pull requests for a month, writes a Polish creative-work description for each, and records them in your KUP Google Sheet.
defaultPrompt: Use $kup to fill my KUP report for the oldest missing month.
Use $kup to preview the KUP report for last month.
Use $kup to catch up every missing month in my KUP sheet.
